'''Everstill Bridge'''<ref>{{Alliance}} [20] [[The Everstill Bridge]]</ref> is the bridge over [[Lake Everstill]] connecting the town of [[Lakeshire]] with the southern part of [[Redridge Mountains]]. It has been damaged by the [[Blackrock clan]],<ref>{{Alliance}} [16] [[The Lost Tools]]</ref> and is undergoing repairs led by [[Foreman Oslow]].
